name: image_generate
description: Generate images from text descriptions. Uses local Stable Diffusion if available, or falls back to an API (requires NLS_IMAGE_API_KEY).

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

manual.overview: Use when you need to create images from text descriptions—illustrations, mockups, or visual assets. Requires NLS_IMAGE_API_KEY for API fallback or local Stable Diffusion.

input.prompt: A minimalist logo of a coffee cup with steam

examples.description: Generate a simple logo for a coffee brand

input.prompt: Futuristic city skyline at sunset, cyberpunk style

tips: Be specific in prompts: include style, lighting, composition for better results
Start with 512x512 for faster generation; use 1024+ for final assets
Avoid overly long prompts—concise descriptions often work better
edge_cases: API failures return unclear errors; verify NLS_IMAGE_API_KEY is set
Very large dimensions may timeout or fail on memory-constrained systems

executor.command: python -c "import urllib.request, json, base64, sys; req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.stability.ai/v1/generation/stable-diffusion-xl-1024-v1-0/text-to-image', data=json.dumps({'text_prompts':[{'text':'{{args.prompt}}'}],'cfg_scale':7,'height':{{args.height}},'width':{{args.width}},'samples':1}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer '+__import__('os').environ.get('NLS_IMAGE_API_KEY','')}, method='POST'); resp=urllib.request.urlopen(req); data=json.loads(resp.read()); img=base64.b64decode(data['artifacts'][0]['base64']); open('{{args.output_path}}','wb').write(img); print('Image saved to {{args.output_path}}')"
